title: Machine learning and genetic algorithm-guided directed evolution for the development of antimicrobial peptides.
extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism layer rebuilt from source-located method/result/figure evidence; generic framework-test placeholders removed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LBDB damages and permeabilizes bacterial cell envelopes, with SEM/TEM showing cytoplasmic leakage, roughened/disrupted surfaces, plasmolysis, vacuolation, cell lysis, and content leakage in treated bacteria.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct microscopy supports membrane/cell-envelope damage under the tested conditions; it does not identify a single molecular receptor.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LBDB shows time- and dose-dependent bactericidal activity against representative Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria in CFU killing assays.

locator: xml:sec=18:Dose-dependent antibacterial activity and time-killing curves

mechanism_claims.limitations: Killing-index values are assay outcome evidence; final artifact does not digitize graph-only points beyond source text values.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: UV absorption evidence supports molecular interaction between LBDB and LPS, with stronger LPS-LBDB signal than LPS alone or LPS-LBDMj and a concentration-dependent intensity increase.
mechanism_claims.limitations: SPR binding was not detected; the source interprets UV absorption as support for interaction rather than a quantitative affinity constant.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NMR supports an extended LBDB structure with a C1-C22 disulfide bond and two 3_10 helices, providing structural context for the activity-enhanced peptide.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural evidence is contextual and does not by itself prove the antibacterial target.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LBDB in Marsupenaeus japonicus infection model
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Co-injection of LBDB with V. alginolyticus or S. aureus reduced shrimp mortality relative to saline or pGFP controls, supporting in vivo antibacterial efficacy under the tested challenge model.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Graph-only mortality curves are not digitized; the source text gives an approximate 30% mortality statement for V. alginolyticus with LBDB.

semantic_quality_control.overclaim_guard: The final claims preserve source limitations: future work is still needed for exact mode of action and graph-only quantitative values are not fabricated.
